results.title: PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx Demonstrates Precision and Reproducibility in Triple-negative Breast Cancer
results.content: These analytical validation studies demonstrate that PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx is precise and reproducible in evaluating PD-L1 protein expression at a CPS ≥ 10 cutoff when used for testing TNBC tissues. **Figure 2:** TNBC tissue specimen (at 20x magnification) stained using PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx and demonstrating CPS ≥ 10 expression. **Figure 3:** TNBC tissue specimen (at 20x magnification) stained using PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx and demonstrating CPS ≥ 10 expression. **Figure 4:** TNBC tissue specimen (at 20x magnification) stained using PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx and demonstrating CPS ≥ 10 expression. Results of this study indicated high overall agreement, suggesting that intra-block heterogeneity does not impact the diagnostic status of PD-L1 in TNBC tissues stained with PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx and that the assay will continue to reliably inform on PD-L1 diagnostic status at the CPS ≥ 10 cutoff for TNBC despite tumor heterogeneity variability24. PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx inter-observer and intra-observer study results emphasized the scoring reproducibility of PD-L1 in TNBC tissue specimens at a CPS ≥ 10 cutoff when scored by different observers as well as by a single observer. All studies presented herein independently exceeded pre-specified criteria of the lower-bound of the two-sided 95% CIs at or above 85%, demonstrating that PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx is a precise and reproducible assay when using the CPS ≥ 10 cutoff on FFPE TNBC tissue specimens. results.content: # IBEX BREAST HER2 ## AI-powered Pathology ### Transforming Cancer Diagnosis - Fully automated “zero-click” AI-powered decision support tool for pathologists scoring HER2 immunohistochemistry (IHC) - Delineates HER2 expression into four standard scores: 0, 1+, 2+ and 3+, based on the 2023 ASCO/CAP guidelines1 - Increases accuracy and reproducibility of HER2 IHC scoring, including the highly subjective HER2-low cases2, 3, 4 - The AI-powered computational pipeline automates and optimizes case review: - “Zero-click” invasive tumor detection (automatically excluding DCIS) - Automated tumor cell identification and staining pattern classification - Scoring explainability with visualization of AI findings and staining pattern percentages Image: Scored HER2 1+ after AI found 17% faint staining and 1.6% moderate (complete and incomplete) staining ### HER2: Prognostic and Predictive Human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2), one of the proteins responsible for division and proliferation of breast cancer cells, is overexpressed in many breast tumors. **Ibex Breast HER2, an AI-powered decision support tool for pathologists, increases the precision and consistency of HER2 IHC scoring, including the highly subjective HER2-low cases, thereby enabling optimized treatment pathways and improved patient outcomes.****2** Ibex Breast HER2 is part of Ibex Breast, an integrated AI solution offering a streamlined diagnostic workflow.8,9 Pathologists can review H&E and IHC stained slides with AI support, facilitating rapid, consistent and objective diagnosis, scoring and reporting of breast biopsies and excisions. AI solutions for ER, PR and Ki-67 coming soon ### Clinically Proven Excellence Pathologists supported by Ibex Breast HER2 showed improvement in scoring accuracy and consistency, as demonstrated by an early evidence program spanning 14 international cancer centers and laboratories and a multi-reader validation study. The AI is exceptionally robust, with high performance across multiple labs, scanners and patient demographics.2,3,4 **100% of pathologists report they feel more confident about their scoring accuracy when assisted by Ibex Breast HER2 and find it useful in their clinical practice.****2** ### Improved Accuracy ### Agreement with ground truth Pathologists reviewing HER2 0 and HER2 1+ slides using Ibex AI showed significantly higher sensitivity for detecting 1+ than the standard of care.

results.content: Accuracy of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) immunohistochemistry scoring by pathologists in breast cancer, including the HER2-low cutoff: HER2 IHC scoring concordance in breast cancer - PMC. Accuracy of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2) immunohistochemistry scoring by pathologists in breast cancer, including the HER2-low cutoff. Substantial agreement was observed among central pathologists across HER2 scores (κ = 0.69), for the HER2-low cutoff (IHC 0 vs. Given that HER2-directed therapy is now available for patients with HER2-low breast cancer, it is important to verify that HER2 IHC scoring is accurate at the HER2-low cutoff. Here, we conducted a real-world cohort study of HER2 scoring using a large sample set (500 clinical samples) across all HER2 IHC scores to assess reproducibility of HER2 scoring between pathologists at a central laboratory trained in HER2-low scoring across a range of cutoffs. Scoring agreement was assessed among three central pathologists trained for HER2-low scoring of breast cancer tumor samples. Central pathologist agreement across HER2 IHC scores for breast cancer samples, used to establish consensus.
